project.name: Mateu Salesforce (SLDS) renderer (preview)
project.description: PREVIEW. The Mateu web renderer drawn with the Salesforce Lightning Design System's blueprints (code BSD-3-Clause; icons and images CC BY-ND 4.0, shipped unmodified with attribution), packaged as static assets served by the backend. Put it on the classpath INSTEAD of mateu-vaadin. Salesforce Sans is not included. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Salesforce.
